photos.c: Voted "Man of the Match" at the Horsham YA Meeting for his 1.78 high jump, James Ganio has made a big impact on the jumps, sprints and shot in our Boy's team.
Above: More great triple jumping came from James Ganio in 1993.

Left: James Ganio hits the sand at Deangate in Kent to win the Southern Premier McDonald's League long jump. On the same afternoon James competed in the high jump, triple jump and ran a leg in the 4 x 400 metres. This outstanding U17 athlete placed 8th in our 1994 long jump rankings and, =8th in the high jump.
